title: Reading a theme before you fill your arms
target: How to use the level themes in R.E.P.O. to decide what is worth carrying, given that each theme brings its own props and its own valuables.
version: R.E.P.O. v0.4.0, as installed for this build (see the sources page for the exact version string)
prerequisites: A crew member who can carry loot
An idea of what extraction is worth

steps.do: Identify the theme in the first room rather than halfway through the level.
steps.because: the game ships separate artwork for each theme, so a theme is there to be seen (level arctic 01)

steps.do: Learn what the theme counts as a valuable before you fill your arms.
steps.because: a level carries a set of valuables it prefers (ValuablePresets)

steps.do: Expect the props to belong to the theme rather than being clutter.
steps.because: each theme brings scenery of its own (Wizard Cloak)

steps.do: Treat a themed room as deliberate rather than random.
steps.because: a level description names special modules of its own (ModulesSpecial)

steps.do: Do not assume two levels of the same theme hold the same things.
steps.because: the preferred valuables are recorded level by level (Level)

commonMistakes: Carrying a full load before working out which theme you are in.
Assuming a themed prop is junk.
Expecting every arctic level to hold the same loot.
sources: This installation of the game, read only. Grounding for each step is on the technical reference pages; no number is estimated.
